dedupe_keys.name: command line tool for virtual traffic flow detection of xuancheng city

description: The Xuancheng traffic-data authors publish a command-line tool for virtual traffic-flow detection. The native description states that it runs on Windows, Linux and macOS and includes instructions and one day of demonstration trajectories. Two archive descriptors identify the tool package and the accompanying trajectory data. The linked article describes city-scale trajectories and traffic-flow resampling for traffic estimation and optimisation. The tool can prepare traffic-flow information for road-network modelling, while the associated trajectory dataset remains a separate existing data record. The deposit states CC BY 4.0 with public, free access. The demonstration concerns Xuancheng; applicability to another network is not tested here. A limitation is that input schemas, algorithms, dependency versions and output accuracy are unspecified in the inspected software metadata. Neither archive was downloaded, installed or executed. This is a traffic-data processing tool; the native metadata does not establish an independent vehicle-motion simulator.
